QuestInfo.name: A Gift for the Test Subject 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2150006##k may look like just another Assistant Plastic Surgeon, but she's actually in charge of mending wounds and healing the Resistance. She has something to ask you, so head over to the #bUnderground Base#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2150006# says #p2151005#'s medicine has helped her focus on taking care of her patients. She is so grateful that she would like to give a present to #p2151005# to thank her. Collect the ingredients that are required for the present. You can find #b#t4032746#s#k by hunting #r#o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k.\n\n#i4032746# #t4032746# #b#c4032746# / 10#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2150006# began to make a present for #p2151005#, so you gave her a few moments.

0.0: Excuse m-me, #h0#... I heard you were the close to #p2151005#. Is that true? I wanted to ask you a favor. Can you help me?

yes.0: Thanks to #p2151005# and her medicine, I can now focus on treating the injured instead of trying to do everything myself. I want to give #p2151005# a present to show my thanks.
yes.1: I've already decided on a present for her. I just have to find the materials to make it. But I can't get them myself because fighting scares m-me! So I'm asking you! Could you please eliminate #r#o2150002#s#k and bring me #b10 #t4032746#s#k?
yes.2: You should be able to find #r#o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k.

no.0: #p2151005# would be disappointed to know that her best friend is so cold-hearted. Please think it over!

1.0: Wow, you've brought all the #t4032746#s I requested! Thank you so much! Please give me a moment. Let me just put her present together...

item.0: You haven't found #b10 #t4032746#s#k yet? You can get #t4032746#s by hunting #r#o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k.
